subject: Elm branch pruning
body: We can prune the lower branches on 3 June. The crew will chip the small limbs and stack the larger pieces beside the garden bed.

subject: Autumn sweep booking
body: I have an opening on Friday at 10. Please leave the fireplace clear and let me know if the flue has a rain cap fitted.

subject: Tank pump-out reminder
body: The pump-out is due before the end of October. We can come on a Wednesday morning and will need the access cover visible before the truck arrives.

subject: Office glass sample
body: The light smoke film is barely visible from the street. I have left a sample strip at reception, and we can install it over two evenings if approved.

subject: Upright piano move
body: The crew can move the upright from the upstairs room on Saturday. Please measure the hallway turn once more so we can bring the right trolley.

subject: Unit size availability
body: We have a medium unit opening next week near the loading bay. It is dry, has a light inside and can be hired month by month.

subject: Packing carton count
body: The estimate includes 18 medium cartons and two wardrobe boxes. We can drop the empty cartons off a few days before the move.

subject: Armchair frame completion
body: The frame is glued and clamped, and the legs are turned. I will start fitting the webbing once the joints have cured overnight.

subject: Farm call route
body: I will visit the southern farms first on Monday and reach the hill property after lunch. Please let me know if the cattle need to be gathered before I arrive.

subject: Saturday grooming space
body: We have one appointment open at 2.30. The terrier can stay for about two hours, and we will call when he is ready for pickup.

subject: Chick collection dates
body: The next batch will be ready on 18 August. Bring a ventilated crate for collection, and we can have the health paperwork at the counter.

subject: Gate hinge stock
body: The heavy hinges are back in stock in both left and right-hand sets. I can reserve a pair for you at the branch until Monday.

subject: Weekend tasting table
body: We will sample the new apple juice from 11 to 1 on Saturday. The bottles are chilled in the rear cabinet, and tasting cups are under the counter.

subject: Milk bottle return
body: The driver will collect the blue crates on Thursday. There are 32 bottles in the wash area and another 16 beside the loading door.

subject: Ravioli production run
body: We are making pumpkin ravioli on Tuesday and spinach ricotta on Wednesday. The labels are printed, and the cartons are ready in the packing room.

subject: Hotel ice machine delivery
body: The new machine arrives on the 6th, with installation planned for the following morning. We have included the drain hose and two spare filters.

subject: Room reset for Monday
body: We can reset the east room with classroom seating and a lectern by 7.30. The projector is already booked for the afternoon session.

subject: Powered site map
body: Sites 11 through 16 have power and shade in the afternoon. I have marked the water point and laundry on the updated park map.

subject: Group kitchen booking
body: The kitchen is reserved for your group from 5 to 6.30. Please wipe the benches after use so the next guests can prepare their dinner.

subject: Lunch menu board
body: The soup today is roasted tomato with basil. The menu board is updated, and the gluten-free rolls are stored in a separate basket.

subject: Trivia night table count
body: We have 14 teams registered for Thursday's trivia night. Could you arrange two extra tables along the back wall and leave a clear aisle to the bar?

subject: Espresso grinder service
body: The grinder burrs have been replaced and aligned. I will return it after the lunch rush and show your barista the new adjustment range.

subject: Knife skills demonstration
body: The chef can lead the demonstration on 23 March. We need six chopping boards, a crate of carrots and a projector for the recipe notes.

subject: Tablecloth delivery
body: The white round cloths are packed in bundles of five. We will deliver them with the napkins at the end of the month.

subject: Cake stand return
body: The silver stand can be returned any weekday before 4. Please wrap the lower plate separately so it does not rub against the base.

subject: Winter storage lift
body: We can lift the sailboat on 9 November if the weather remains calm. The owner can choose a covered berth or the outside cradle when we speak.

subject: Dry bag size exchange
body: The 20-litre bag is too small for the trip kit. We have the 30-litre version in orange and blue, and can swap it over at the shop.

subject: Beginner course calendar
body: The next beginner course starts on 5 May and runs for four Saturdays. We provide buoyancy vests, and learners should bring a warm layer.

subject: Indoor assessment evening
body: We have room for five learners on Thursday at 6. The instructor will assess basic knots and belay technique before planning the outdoor day.

subject: Family tent pickup
body: The four-person tent is packed with its poles and groundsheet. You can collect it after 2 on Friday and return it clean on Monday.

subject: Platform sign replacement
body: The new platform signs are at the central depot. We can install them during the quiet period next Tuesday morning.

subject: Hangar inspection notes
body: The inspection is complete and the cabin trim has been refitted. The mechanic will send the maintenance log after the final engine run.

subject: Pallet paperwork
body: The paperwork is ready for the three pallets from the north warehouse. Please confirm the delivery address and preferred arrival window before dispatch.

subject: Museum trip seating plan
body: The coach has 48 seats and a luggage bay under the floor. We can reserve the first row for the group leaders if that helps with boarding.

subject: Weekend parcel round
body: The Saturday round starts at 8.30 from the old post office. Please sort the parcels by suburb and place the return envelopes in a separate crate.

subject: Council newsletter fold
body: The newsletter is ready for folding, with the event calendar on the centre spread. We can post the first stack on Tuesday after the address labels arrive.

subject: Workshop room setup
body: The advice clinic workshop needs a circle of chairs and a flip chart. We have booked the room from 1 to 4 on the 13th.

subject: Visitor map reprint
body: The updated map includes the new walking track and public toilets. The printer can deliver 2,000 copies before the school holiday period.

subject: Small grant information session
body: We will hold the information session online on 17 April at noon. The application dates and eligibility notes are on the council calendar.

subject: Garden volunteer day
body: The next volunteer day is 20 June. We will prune the rose walk in the morning and tidy the potting shed after lunch, weather allowing.
